title: BIOL 210: Genetics and Genomes
text:
BIOL 210 - Genetics and Genomes
Sample University, Department of Biology
Winter 2027

Week-by-week schedule
Week 1: Mendelian genetics, Punnett squares, test crosses
Week 2: Chromosomes and linkage, recombination, gene mapping
Week 3: DNA as genetic material, replication, repair of DNA damage
Week 4: Gene expression: transcription, RNA processing, translation
Week 5: Regulation of gene expression in bacteria (the lac operon) and in eukaryotes
Week 6: Mutations and their effects. Reading week at the end of this week.
Week 7: Population genetics and Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium
Week 8: Genomics, sequencing technologies, and CRISPR gene editing

Assessments
Problem set 1 is worth 8% and is due at the end of week 3.
Problem set 2 is worth 8% and is due in week 6 (exact day to be announced).
Lab report: 12%, due Monday, March 1, 2027, 5:00 PM.
Midterm: 30%, held in the week after reading week. Date TBA.
Final exam: 42%, exam period (date to be announced).

topics: DNA replication, repair and molecular basis

concepts.label: Mendelian genetics
concepts.summary: Patterns of inheritance of traits passed from parents to offspring.

concepts.label: Punnett squares
concepts.summary: Diagram for predicting offspring genotype and phenotype ratios from parental crosses.

concepts.label: Test crosses
concepts.summary: Crossing an individual of unknown genotype with a recessive homozygote to infer its genotype.

concepts.label: Chromosomes and linkage
concepts.summary: Genes located on the same chromosome tend to be inherited together.

concepts.label: Recombination
concepts.summary: Exchange of genetic material between homologous chromosomes that breaks linkage.

concepts.label: Gene mapping
concepts.summary: Using recombination frequencies to determine the relative positions of genes on chromosomes.

concepts.label: DNA as genetic material
concepts.summary: Evidence that DNA, rather than protein, carries genetic information.
concepts.topic: DNA replication, repair and molecular basis

concepts.label: DNA replication
concepts.summary: Copying of the DNA molecule before cell division.
concepts.topic: DNA replication, repair and molecular basis

concepts.label: DNA repair
concepts.summary: Mechanisms that correct damage to DNA.
concepts.topic: DNA replication, repair and molecular basis

concepts.label: Transcription
concepts.summary: Synthesis of RNA from a DNA template.

concepts.label: RNA processing
concepts.summary: Modification of primary RNA transcripts before they are used for translation.

concepts.label: Translation
concepts.summary: Synthesis of a polypeptide from an mRNA template by ribosomes.

concepts.label: Gene regulation in bacteria
concepts.summary: Control of gene expression in bacteria, illustrated by the lac operon.

concepts.label: Lac operon
concepts.summary: Bacterial operon system regulating lactose metabolism genes.

concepts.label: Gene regulation in eukaryotes
concepts.summary: Control of gene expression in eukaryotic cells.

concepts.label: Mutations and effects
concepts.summary: Changes in DNA sequence and their consequences for gene function.

concepts.label: Population genetics
concepts.summary: Study of allele and genotype frequencies in populations and how they change.

concepts.label: Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium
concepts.summary: Null model describing expected genotype frequencies in a non-evolving population.

concepts.label: Genomics
concepts.summary: Analysis of whole genomes and their sequences.

concepts.label: Sequencing technologies
concepts.summary: Methods for determining DNA sequences.

concepts.label: CRISPR gene editing
concepts.summary: Technique for targeted modification of genomic DNA.
